title: Implementation Manager, Broker
description:
About Rippling 
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling , you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @ Rippling .com addresses.
 About the role 
 Implementation is an essential differentiator for Rippling . As an Implementation Manager, you will work with our customers to implement and drive the adoption of Rippling ’s suite of products. You will consult with the customer to understand their unique objectives and leverage deep knowledge of Rippling ’s products as well as a strong commitment to customer experience to help clients realize the full potential of our offerings. 
 What you will do 
 Partner one-on-one with clients to develop custom plans and implement the Rippling products they have purchased across HR, Payroll, Benefits Administration, IT platform, and various other products tailored to the customer’s specific business objectives
 Proactively manage the implementation process end-to-end, consulting with customers to align on target timelines and specific goals, ensuring that each milestone meets their operational needs
 Drive adoption of purchased products providing bespoke guidance, best practices, and insights that empower clients to maximize the platform’s capabilities
 Partner with Sales, Account Management, Technical Account Management, and Support to ensure seamless hand-offs and long-term customer success
 Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to offer feedback on customer insights, partner on technical issues, and advocate for product enhancements that align with customer needs and industry trends
 Collaborate with internal teams in the development of processes and best practices which integrates customer feedback and learnings to increase operational efficiency and success 
 What you will need 
 2+ years of hands-on experience in Implementation and/or Customer Experience at a rapidly growing SaaS company.
 Proven project management experience, deploying multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
 Stellar communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills along with a deep commitment to driving an exceptional customer experience.
 Ability to effectively collaborate with partners across Sales, CX, Product, and Engineering teams
 Bonus 
 1+ years experience in a customer-facing position within the HCM or IT space (HR, Payroll, Benefits, Identity Management, Device Management, etc).
 Additional Information 
 Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email 
 Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Onboarding Specialist
description:
About Us: 
 We're not just another SaaS company. We're chiropractors and software veterans who got tired of watching practices struggle with clunky, outdated systems. So we built something better.
 ChiroHD is the cloud-based practice management platform that actually gets chiropractic. Scheduling, EHR, billing, patient communication - everything a modern practice needs, built specifically for how chiropractors actually work. No more trying to force-fit horizontal software into your vertical world. We've cracked the code on product-market fit - prepped, proven, and ready for scale!
 Role Overview: 
 As an Onboarding Specialist, you’re the first person our new customers work with after they sign, and you set the tone for their entire experience with us. You’ll lead live kickoff and training calls, provide guidance and support as customers work through their own account setup, and help ensure they feel confident and prepared to use the product by the time they go live.
 Our onboarding process is primarily self-guided, meaning customers are responsible for completing their own setup, while you serve as a trusted resource to answer questions, provide direction, and help them navigate the process successfully.
 This is a customer-focused, hands-on role on a growing onboarding team. Your work directly impacts how quickly customers become successful with our product and their long-term satisfaction and retention.
 What You’ll Do 
 Lead Live Training. Run kickoff and training calls that introduce new customers to the onboarding process, explain setup expectations, and demonstrate how to use the product in their day-to-day operations.
 Support Customers Through Go-Live. Serve as a resource throughout the customer-led onboarding process, providing guidance, answering questions, setting clear expectations, and helping customers stay on track toward a successful launch.
 Assist with Launch Readiness. Provide guidance on account configuration and complete light configuration tasks when needed to support a successful go-live, while ensuring customers remain responsible for their own account setup.
 Follow Up Proactively. Reach out to customers who are stalled or struggling, offer assistance when needed, and flag early signs of risk to your manager.
 Improve the Process. Keep onboarding records accurate and current, and share customer feedback and recurring friction points with the team so we can continuously improve the onboarding experience.
 Who You Are: 
 Experienced . You have 1–3 years of experience in SaaS onboarding, implementation, or a similar customer-facing role.
 Effective Communicator . You’re a confident, friendly communicator who can lead a live training call and make a non-technical person feel capable.
 Customer-Focused . You care about customers’ outcomes, not just finishing the checklist. You want them to be using the product and getting value from it.
 Organized and Dependable . You can manage a full caseload of clinics at different stages without losing track of next steps or commitments.
 Quick Learner . You pick up new software quickly and can explain it simply, even when you’re still learning it. 
 Self-Directed . You’re comfortable working remotely, taking feedback, and sharing what you learn with the team. 
 Preferred Experience (Nice-to-Have): 
 Hands-on experience in a medical practice or with EHR software ( ChiroHD preferred)
 Experience using Customer Success tools like Gainsight or ChurnZero
 History of supporting small business customers directly
 Proven ability to document, refine, and improve workflows
 Skillful at using AI tools to boost efficiency and productivity
 Non-Negotiables (Disqualifiers): 
 Lacks prior experience in SaaS onboarding or software implementation
 Lacks customer-facing experience conducting live training or kickoff calls
 Unable to work standard working hours in Central or Eastern Time
 Why ChiroHD ? 
 Impact & Growth: 
 Vertical SaaS category leader in a wide market.
 PE-backed with $26M in growth capital to scale aggressively.
 Established product-market fit; scaling outbound-led growth engine now.
 High-caliber sales culture focused on coaching, commercial excellence, and real career growth.
 Direct leadership access, no bureaucracy, high visibility.
 Culture & Values: 
 Customer-obsessed team that puts patient care at the center of everything we do
 Low-ego, builder-first environment where the best ideas win
 High-accountability culture with emphasis on ownership and results
 Commitment to work-life balance and professional development
 Compensation & Benefits: 
 Competitive salary
 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance 
 Flexible PTO and remote-first culture

title: Customer Success Manager, SMB
description:
NikoHealth is a fast-growing healthcare SaaS company with an end-to-end platform for Durable and Home Medical Equipment (DME/HME) providers across the US. Intake, orders, billing, inventory, and resupply all run through NikoHealth , and our AI features help providers do more with less. Our customers rely on us every day to get equipment to patients and get paid for that work.
 We're looking for a Customer Success Manager, SMB to join our growing team and own the post-implementation relationship with a large portfolio of small and independent DME/HME providers. Once implementation is complete, you'll be the customer's primary strategic advisor, focused on adoption, value, renewals, and long-term success with NikoHealth .
This role is about more than relationship management. It requires product fluency, operational thinking, and a strong understanding of customer workflows. Our customers often run lean teams, where one person may wear several hats, from patient intake to billing to managing equipment inventory, and they work within complex payer, documentation, and resupply requirements. You'll guide them in using NikoHealth to its full potential so they can streamline operations, improve cash flow, and better serve their patients.
Because this is a large book of business, success means working at scale. You'll use data to decide where your time matters most, and digital, one-to-many engagement, such as automated email journeys and group webinars, to support every customer well, saving one-on-one time for the accounts and moments that need it most.
 The Team Behind You 
You won't be doing this alone. Our SMB customers are supported by a whole team, so you can focus on the relationship, the strategy, and the moments where you add the most value. You'll partner closely with:
 Customer Support , who handle day-to-day questions and troubleshooting.
 Training , who deliver user training, webinars, and self-serve learning through NikoHealth University.
 Clearinghouse , who help customers with claims, payer enrollment, and billing connectivity.
 Implementation , who onboard new customers and hand them off to you ready to succeed.
 Product , who answer deeper platform questions and act on the feedback you bring from customers.
 Your Customer Success peers and leadership , who share what's working, offer coaching, and help with complex accounts.
 What You'll Do 
 Manage a large portfolio of SMB accounts as their main point of contact after implementation, using health scores, product usage, renewal dates, and support trends to decide which customers need one-on-one attention and which are best served through digital engagement.
 Design and run digital outreach at scale, including automated email campaigns and journeys in ChurnZero and group webinars, to drive adoption and renewals across your book, and measure what works.
 Lead renewals for your portfolio, planning early and working with the broader team to address any risks along the way.
 Identify growth opportunities and help customers expand their use of NikoHealth , including AI features where they fit the customer's goals.
 Develop deep knowledge of customer businesses, including operational goals, user roles (e.g., billers, intake, inventory), and key challenges.
 Drive adoption by guiding users on billing, revenue cycle, inventory, and order workflows, and by bringing in our Training team when customers need deeper enablement.
 Build repeatable plays, templates, and automations, and use AI to reduce manual work so your time goes where it counts.
 Share product feedback and insights from the field to inform the roadmap and service improvements.
 What Success Looks Like 
 Your customers renew, and many grow with us.
 More of your customers are actively using the parts of NikoHealth that matter most to them.
 Customers hear from you before they need to ask for help, whether one-on-one or through well-timed digital outreach.
 You've made at least one part of how we work faster, simpler, or better.
 What You'll Bring 
 5+ years of experience in Customer Success or Account Management at a SaaS company, including ownership of renewals, ideally in the healthcare, healthtech, or RCM space.
 Proven success managing a large book of business in a scaled or digital-led CS model, including building one-to-many programs such as email campaigns, CS platform journeys, or webinars.
 Comfort using data to make decisions and measure results.
 Hands-on experience with a Customer Success platform such as ChurnZero, Totango, or Gainsight.
 Everyday use of AI tools in your work, such as for meeting preparation, customer communications, or identifying trends.
 Exceptional product aptitude, with the ability to learn NikoHealth deeply and explain workflows clearly to a range of user roles.
 A consultative, customer-first mindset with a passion for improving operations and driving business outcomes.
 A love of working cross-functionally in a growing company.
 Bonus Points 
 Experience in the DME/HME industry, with DME software platforms, or with medical billing systems.
 Background in training, enablement, or customer education.
 Familiarity with Salesforce, Intercom, Slack, and Jira.
 Why NikoHealth 
 Meaningful work. Behind every account are patients waiting on equipment.
 Real influence. You'll report to the VP of Customer Success and help shape how Customer Success grows at NikoHealth .
 An AI-forward team. We use AI every day to spend less time on busywork and more time with customers.

 About Mixpanel 
 Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com .
 About the Customer Digital Experience Team 
 Customer Digital Experience sits within the technical arm of Mixpanel's Customer Success organization.
 Our sharpest focus is the digital-only segment: thousands of companies with no proactive account coverage. Some have technical resources available to them, but that support is entirely reactive. It answers the ticket and solves the problem in front of it. Nobody is watching for the customer who implemented and then never built a report, or the account whose usage has been sliding for a month. Our job is to be proactive,, and everything we build should be as automated as possible, without a human initiating it.
 Our programs run across the full customer base and are not one-size-fits-all. We build flows that branch and adapt by segment, tuning the content, timing, and channel for who's receiving them. An onboarding flow for a digital-only customer carries the whole experience; the version reaching an account with a dedicated team is tuned to complement what that team is already doing. Same underlying program, deliberately different execution, continuously optimized based on what each segment responds to.
 We're close to the data and to the technical reality of how customers implement and use Mixpanel. We're not guessing at what customers are doing; we can see it, and we build against it. This is a small, new team standing up a new function. The playbook isn't written yet; we're writing it together.
 About the Role 
 As our Digital Adoption & Lifecycle Manager, you'll own the communications that drive adoption, retention, and expansion across Mixpanel's customer base, with our digital-only customers as the sharpest test of whether the programs work. You'll design lifecycle programs triggered by real behavior: a team that just implemented but hasn't built their first report, an account whose query volume dropped for three straight weeks, a power user hitting the edge of their current plan. Then you'll write the emails and in-product messages that move them forward.
 This is a builder's role, not a maintainer's role. You'll define the segmentation, write the copy, set up the triggers, instrument the measurement, and then argue with the data about what to change.

You'll support adoption initiatives coming out of Product, turning a launch into something customers actually try. And you'll take cues from customer-facing teams about what's landing and what isn't. Very little of this job happens alone.
 You'll also help define what agentic customer success looks like at Mixpanel. The scaled programs we build today are rules and triggers; the ones we build next will involve AI agents that can interpret a customer's situation, decide what that customer needs, and act. We're early here and we don't have the answers. We want someone who is already experimenting, who already has opinions about where agents help and where they break trust, and who wants to shape how this gets built.
 If you like clean handoffs and finished systems, this isn't it. If you want to build the thing from zero and own the number it moves, read on.
